title: Without the Shedding of Blood
speaker: Jonathan Baird
summary: There was no other way. Our own blood couldn't save us. It had to be Jesus, and because he shed his blood, we stand before God without stain.
exhortation: There was no other way for us to be saved. Our own blood couldn't save us. No one else could have died for us. It wouldn't have done a thing. It had to be Jesus. Nothing else would suffice. If Jesus had not given his life and shed his blood on the cross, we would have been utterly lost.

It's impossible to comprehend how pure, precious and powerful the blood of Jesus is. But we know this: without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness of sins. And because Jesus willingly laid down his life and shed his blood for us, we are cleansed from our sin and pure before God, without stain or blemish.

That isn't easy to believe when we look at our sin. So what we need to do is look to Jesus, our perfect substitute, who loved us and gave himself up for us. That's the goal this morning: to fix our eyes on Jesus.
prayer: Lord, thank you for coming and shedding your blood so that we might be cleansed from our sin. There was no other way. When we deserved your wrath and judgment, you came down in love and took our place on the cross, nailing our sin to the wood and reconciling us to you.
Fill our hearts today with gratitude and thanksgiving for what you've done. Fill us with hope for the future, knowing you are working for our good. We pray this in Jesus' name. Amen.
